requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

390-643-1486-4231--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Maskwood Nexus, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Hulking Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Maskwood Nexus, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

997-5621-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Arid Archway.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Arid Archway from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Arid Archway enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability
Repeat.

1263-2301-2921-4871.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
When Bloodsoaked Champion dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Abzan Ascendancy trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

2034-2363-5224-7693.easyPrerequisites: Armor Wars' second chapter ability has resolved this turn.
2034-2363-5224-7693.description:
Cast Hangarback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Hangarback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hangarback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Hangarback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2438-3644-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
2438-3644-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2074-6798-6972.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Vorapede
When Vorapede dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Umbral Collar Zealot abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
2074-6798-6972.notes: If Vorapede starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1295-3832-6006.description:
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {W/U}.
Activate Puresight Merrow by paying {W/U} and untapping it, exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat until your deck size is less than or equal to 2 plus your devotion to blue.
Activate Puresight Merrow by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Thassa's Oracle by paying {U}{U}. When it enters, it triggers, causing you to win the game.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5256-6972-7156.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

457-1329-3338-3446-7112.description:
If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Herald of Kozilek.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

250-779-1479-3678-5411.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-3678-5411.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Retreat to Emeria and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Retreat to Emeria trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Retreat to Emeria triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

413-2232-3542-6843.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
413-2232-3542-6843.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Anti-Venom by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}{W}.
When Anti-Venom enters, its first ability, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the Anti-Venom trigger, returning Palinchron from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Palinchron enters, it, Blasting Station and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station triggers, untapping it.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Anti-Venom from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Palinchron.
Repeat.

2034-5968-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1062-1742-5674-5870.notablePrerequisites: You have at least 3 land cards in your hand.
1062-1742-5674-5870.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a land card.
Slogurk triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 1 two additional times.
Activate Slogurk by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Slogurk leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning three land cards from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Slogurk by paying {E} due to Primal Prayers.
When Slogurk enters, Guide of Souls triggers, causing you to get {E} and gain 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-3327-5078-6118.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game
392-3327-5078-6118.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and sacrificing Dargo.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.

4050-4365-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {1}{W}.
When Whitemane Lion enters the battlefield, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating two 1/1 Cat creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the Cats, adding {1}{W}.
Repeat.

586-4772-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Priest of Gix that are 6/6 Dinosaurs.
When the Priest of Gix tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, adding six {B}.
Repeat.

190-5344.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three opponents.
190-5344.description:
Cast Fractured Identity by paying {3}{W}{U}, exiling Charismatic Conqueror and causing each opponent to create a token copy of it.
When the Charismatic Conqueror tokens enter the battlefield, each opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers twice.
Because there will be two Charismatic Conqueror triggers for each token created, at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token will be generated on resolution.
When the Vampire enters the battlefield, each other opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers.
Repeat form step 3 using the Vampire token instead, which creates a mandatory infinite loop that will cause the game to end in a draw.

851-1339-2034-5185.description:
Activate Tymora's Invoker by paying {8}, causing you to draw two cards.
The Locust God triggers twice, creating four 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing the Insects, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.

259-933-2103.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Conjurer's Closet triggers, blinking Halo-Charged Skaab.
When Halo-Charged Skaab enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each player to mill two cards and put Capture of Jingzhou on top of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next durn, drawing Capture of Jingzhou during your draw step.
Repeat.

224-433-1373-4482-5168.notablePrerequisites:
Llanowar Scout and Bloom Tender do not have summoning sickness.
You have a land card in hand.
224-433-1373-4482-5168.description:
Activate Llanowar Scout by tapping it, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
The land enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm twice, untapping Llanowar Scout and Bloom Tender.
Activate Bloom Tender by tapping it, adding at least {G}{U}{R}.
Activate Mina and Denn by paying {R}{G} and returning a land from the battlefield to your hand, giving a creature trample until end of turn.
Repeat.

4336-4763-4955-5147.description:
Equip Kobolds of Kher Keep with Grafted Wargear.
Sacrifice Kobolds of Kher Keep to Goblin Bombardment to deal 1 damage to any target.
Koll triggers, returning Kobolds of Kher Keep to you hand.
Cast Kobolds of Kher Keep.
Repeat.

618-2062-2857.description:
Cast Kiki-Jiki, letting him resolve.
Marauding Raptor triggers, dealing 2 damage to Kiki-Jiki.
With the trigger on the stack, tap Kiki-Jiki to create a token copy of Adarkar Valkyrie with haste.
Tap the Adarkar Valkyrie token targeting Kiki-Jiki.
Allow the triggers to resolve.
Kiki-Jiki dies to the 2 damage and is returned to the battlefield by Adarkar Valkyrie.
Repeat.

148-2353.notablePrerequisites:
Keen Sense attached to Niv-Mizzet.
You have a way to draw a card.
148-2353.description:
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Keen Sense triggers, allowing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
